author: subliminal
name: Autochrome CLUT
description: An emulation of Autochrome Lumière, the early color photography process with century-old, painterly colors (see https://blog.scienceandmediamuseum.org.uk/christina-mervyn-o-gorman-1913-photograph-girl-in-red/, https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n7eBDh5V-og, https://allthatsinteresting.com/autochrome-old-color-photos#10 and https://visualhistory.livejournal.com/tag/autochrome for examples), implemented through the color look up table module.
